messages:
Sam (marketing): Heads up 1: target launch next Thursday. Need pinned changelog URL, live docs examples, three short benchmark bullets, and a webinar demo owner by EOD Tue. Also: embargo window and regional rollout notes. Who can demo? @Jo?
Jo (eng): I can do it. Plan to demo canary traffic split + region failover. Need changelog final link and a sample request showing X-Prefix-Cache.
Anya (eng): Changelog draft is at https://redwood.internal/changelogs/1.6-wip. Added notes on region routing and canary flag names.
Luis (docs): I'll update quickstart and add live examples (curl + python) and a tiny migration FAQ. ETA Wed morning.
Riley (marketing): Marketing wants bullets: p50 delta, token-cost %, and latency tail improvement. Also an embargo sentence for partners and press. Priya please confirm safe numbers.
Priya (product): Conservative public figures: p50 ~40% down on common workloads, p95 ~28% down, token cost ~16% lower with cache+batch. Embargo: do not share before 09:00 PT release day. DMing spreadsheet.
Sam (marketing): Webinar preference: 9am PT release morning. Jo demo, Priya product narrative, Sam moderate. Need slides + raw CSV. Also need the 'Request demo' CTA to include utm_campaign=rls-176 and region_hint param.
Jo (eng): Bench CSV: s3://bench/release-176/summary.csv. I'll attach a small cleaned CSV to the slides channel.
Riley (marketing): Inbound routing: sales webhook is https://hooks.redwood.com/leads-v3. Include utm_campaign=rls-176 and model_hint fields. Who will smoke-test?
Jo (eng): I'll run a staging smoke test and paste the curl here.
Jo (eng): curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/leads-v3 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"qa+lead@example.com","utm_campaign":"rls-176","model_hint":"redwood-1-optimized","region_hint":"eu-west-1"}'
ci-bot: Preflight started: docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will post updates.
Anya (eng): Canary plan: start 3% global with region-aware routing, monitor errors + latency for 20m, bump to 30% if healthy, full ramp by +3hrs. Rollback CLI: `rb rollback --release 177123 --reason 'perf-regress'`.
Luis (docs): Legal blurb approved: "Private deployments keep customer data in their VPC; see security page for controls." Adding to docs and post.
Sam (marketing): Final owners: slides (Riley), demo script (Jo), docs publish (Luis), changelog pin (Anya), webhook test (Jo), bench confirm (Anya). Dry run Sat 08:30 PT. If anything blocks, drop it here and tag me.
